title: Father & Sons in Resort Swimming Pool, 1956 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid June 1956 black-and-white square snapshot capturing a father with his two young sons swimming in a pool during a family vacation. The boys sit gleefully inside large black rubber inner tubes while their father stands behind them in the water. The background features a classic mid-century motel or resort complex with a prominent palm tree, poolside lounge umbrella, and 1950s vehicles parked along the drive. The margin of the deckled-edge print features the date stamp 'JUN • 56'.
